tk_source: M=fibonacciCountdigits;F=countDigitsInStr(val:Str;other:Str):i64{if(val=other){<0};let cnt=mut.0;let n=val.len;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){let c=val[i];if(c>47){if(c<58){cnt=cnt+1}};};<cnt};F=fibonacci(n:i64):i64{if(n=0){<0};if(n=1){<1};let a=mut.0;let b=mut.1;lp(let i=2;i<n+1;i=i+1){let next=a+b;a=b;b=next;};<b};F=fibonacciCountdigitsinstr(val:Str;other:Str):i64{<fibonacci(countDigitsInStr(val;other))};
